title: TCG:SAS-149

objectives.text:
Put the Gargoyle into zone 4 with 3 Water counters on it.

 At the start of each round, put the Gargoyle 1 zone closer to zone 1.

 When the Gargoyle is put into a player's zone 5, that player may return a Free Action card from their discard pile to their hand.

 If you catch the Gargoyle, you win.
